Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
articles.snippet: Zakura is pushing to stop new payments into Sapling sooner, citing the possibility that AI-assisted discoveries could weaken the math protecting it.

articles.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
articles.snippet: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

articles.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
articles.snippet: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.

articles.title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
articles.snippet: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.
